summary: Spec-generated market commands reach the selected market through a client hook that rewrites the placeholder host, swaps the generated persistent cookie jar for an in-memory jar seeded from the imported session, and merges every Set-Cookie the market answers with back into that session file.
reason: The shop rotates its session cookie on most requests; a second cookie store (cookies.json) or a read-only copy goes stale, so generated and hand-written commands would disagree about the login and renewals by generated calls would be lost.
validated_outcome: TestSessionWriteBackMergesIntoFile: a rotated cookie reaches the session file and no file is created when none exists.
